doc: Marks D_80085F98 \"busy\" (=1), and if D_80073734[0] (active-entry count) > 0, walks D_80085458 (stride 0x78 struct array) for slots whose f06 < 0x10 (u16) AND f1a != 0 (u16); for each match, builds a request (type/count=3, value=D_80073740[i], plus the slot's f10/f12 fields) and dispatches it via func_8005F134. After the scan (or immediately if the count was <= 0), marks D_80086C00[arg0].field_2 = 1 (active), sets D_800737A4[0] = 1, then clears D_80085F98[0] back to 0.
